StorageLayouts.mapSavedData: Saved floor layouts and inventory in this building
StorageLayouts.mapNoFloors: No floors have been saved for this building.
StorageLayouts.title: Storage building planner
StorageLayouts.description: Plan buildings, floors, and QR-addressable storage spots.
StorageLayouts.emptyBody: Create a building to start defining floor-by-floor capacity.
StorageLayouts.noMatchesBody: Change the search text or status filter to see more buildings.
StorageLayouts.planningNoticeBody: Drafts define building dimensions, floors, and storage spots. Activate a layout when the plan is ready.
StorageLayouts.name: Building name
StorageLayouts.settingsDescription: Update the building envelope or add more floors.
StorageLayouts.addReservedZoneDescription: Define the unavailable floor area before adding it to the plan.
StorageLayouts.editReservedZoneDescription: Change this unavailable area on the floor plan.
StorageLayouts.dragReservedZoneHint: Drag the reserved block to position it · Arrow keys move 0.1 m
StorageLayouts.reservedZoneOutsideFloor: Outside or overlaps an existing area
StorageLayouts.storageZonesHelp: Place QR-addressable storage spots in the usable floor area.
StorageLayouts.addStorageZoneDescription: Define one QR-addressable stack position within this floor.
StorageLayouts.editStorageZoneDescription: Change this zone's position and capacity. Its location code and QR value stay the same.
StorageLayouts.modeSimpleHelp: Backwards-compatible default: one automatic leaf position and no rack setup.
StorageLayouts.modeFloorPositionsHelp: Add named markers or grid cells such as P-12 and GRID-B4 with exact X/Y geometry.
StorageLayouts.modeRackHelp: Generate exact leaf addresses from rack identity, bay, level, and slot. Elevation comes from the rack level.
StorageLayouts.modePlatformHelp: Set the platform base elevation, then add exact positions on its surface.
StorageLayouts.modeGuideDescription: Compare addressing, scan behavior, and elevation rules before choosing a mode.
StorageLayouts.modeSimpleRule: 1 automatic leaf · area scan selects it · fixed at floor Z = 0
StorageLayouts.modeFloorPositionsRule: Multiple X/Y leaves · area scan requires an exact child · fixed at floor Z = 0
StorageLayouts.modeRackRule: Fixture › bay › level › slot · Z is derived from the rack level
StorageLayouts.modePlatformRule: Surface positions inherit base Z · base elevation + stack height must fit the floor
StorageLayouts.storageAreaHeightSummary: Base Z {base} m · maximum height {height} m · top Z {top} m
StorageLayouts.reservedAreaHeightSummary: Z 0–{height} m · reserved through the full floor height
StorageLayouts.dragStorageZoneHint: Drag the stack to position it · Arrow keys move 0.1 m
StorageLayouts.zoneOutsideFloor: Outside the floor or overlaps an existing area
StorageLayouts.storageZoneCreated: Storage stack created. Its location code and QR label are ready for activation.
StorageLayouts.storageZoneUpdated: Storage stack updated. Its location code and QR label are unchanged.
StorageLayouts.leafCount: {count, plural, one {# leaf position} other {# leaf positions}}
StorageLayouts.positionEditorHelp: Position identity and QR stay unchanged when its X/Y geometry moves.
StorageLayouts.positionSaved: Exact position saved. Its location identity and QR remain stable.
StorageLayouts.occupiedPositionConfirmation: This geometry change affects occupied position LPNs: {lpns}. Confirm only after checking the physical move.
StorageLayouts.generateRackHelp: Create stable leaf addresses for every bay, level, and slot. Level elevation is derived automatically.
StorageLayouts.storageConditionHelp: Recommendations compare this condition with the product requirement. Unconfigured conditions are shown as unknown.
StorageLayouts.emptyStack: No handling units in this stack.
StorageLayouts.scanPlacement: Scan finished goods to an exact position
StorageLayouts.scanPlacementHelp: A one-position area selects automatically. A multi-position area requires the operator to scan or choose the exact child leaf before the ledger move.
StorageLayouts.exactPositionRequired: This area has multiple leaf positions. Scan one or choose its exact address:
StorageLayouts.addressNotFound: No active storage area or position matches this scan.
StorageLayouts.stackHeightWarning: Placed at level {level}, but the stack is higher than the planned limit.
StorageLayouts.saveAndContinue: Save and continue to storage stacks
StorageLayouts.savedContinueToStorage: Floor saved. Continue by drawing storage stacks in the usable area.
StorageLayouts.saveReservedBeforeStorage: Save unavailable areas before drawing storage stacks
StorageLayouts.saveReservedBeforeStorageHelp: This keeps the server plan and the canvas in sync and prevents overlapping locations.
StorageLayouts.activeLayoutReadOnly: This layout is active. Stack geometry is read-only; use Putaway to move goods.
StorageLayouts.archivedLayoutReadOnly: This layout is archived and cannot be changed.
StorageLayouts.layoutViewOnly: View-only access. A warehouse manager can change this layout.
StorageLayouts.quickChangeActiveHelp: Edit dimensions and spot positions while keeping the layout active.
StorageLayouts.occupiedChangeBlocked: This area has reserved or stored pallets. Release reservations or reassign pallets before changing its structure.
StorageLayouts.layoutChangedRetry: The layout changed while you were editing. Refresh to review the latest version, then try again.
StorageLayouts.impactReviewDescription: This area has reserved or stored pallets. Reassign them before changing its dimensions or position.
StorageLayouts.palletsAtLocation: {count, plural, one {# pallet at this location} other {# pallets at this location}}
StorageLayouts.impactAuditHelp: Location labels can change without moving pallets. Structural changes remain blocked until pallets are reassigned.
StorageLayouts.noActiveStorageStacksHelp: Create stacks in the storage building planner and activate the layout before moving goods.
StorageLayouts.reviewDescription: Confirm every floor and calculated capacity before making this layout active.
StorageLayouts.loadError: The storage layout could not be loaded.
StorageLayouts.saved: Floor saved. Building totals were recalculated.
StorageLayouts.writeError: The change could not be saved: {code}
StorageLayouts.dragHint: Drag the floor on the grid to position it. Placement snaps to 1 m; arrow keys also move the selected floor.
StorageLayouts.storageStackRequired: Add a storage stack before activation
StorageLayouts.storageStackRequiredHelp: Add at least one storage spot before activating the plan.
StorageLayouts.validationPassed: Dimensions, floor sequence, unavailable areas, and storage stacks passed validation.
StorageLayouts.noMatchingSpotsHelp: Try another location name, code or pallet number.
StorageLayouts.noStorageSpotsHelp: Add a location to start planning this floor.
StorageLayouts.noPalletsAtSpot: No stored or reserved units yet
StorageLayouts.mapInspectHint: Select a location or pallet to inspect. Use Edit to change a location.
